chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Rabi' ibn Abdullah, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
When the man dies, the eldest of his sons inherits his sword, his Mus'haf (Quran codex), his ring, and his armor.
ai.seo_question: What specific items does the eldest son inherit according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the concept of *fayd* (special inheritance) for the eldest son, reflecting the pre-Islamic Arab custom of honoring the heir apparent with symbols of authority and status. In Shia jurisprudence, these items are considered distinct from the general estate (*turath*), serving as a recognition of the eldest son's role in preserving the father's legacy and military or scholarly identity.
